ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 45:55 ratio of high-intensity white/light-grey pixels to low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large, contiguous white zones occupy the distal sections of both lobes. A high-contrast black central region extends from the peduncle attachment to the median notch and along the proximal trailing edge of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with an approximate pixel angle of 70-80 degrees and a deep bounding-box penetration into the central fluke mass.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with varying pixel-amplitudes across the entire trailing edge boundary, exhibiting several prominent jagged peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve along the trailing edge of both lobes, tapering to sharp, slightly upward-curved tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized high-contrast white clusters situated at the extreme tips of both lobes, likely corresponding to barnacle attachment sites or resulting scars.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct white linear marks on the dark central pigmentation; notable intersecting 'X' pattern on the left-central lobe and parallel horizontal rake marks on the right-central lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy irregular calcification or parasitic colonization visible at the distal tips of both lobes, disrupting the smooth geometric contour.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly unique intersecting 'X' shaped rake mark located in the black pigmentation zone of the left lobe.
